name: rt_tgsigqueueinfo
synopsis: int syscall(SYS_rt_tgsigqueueinfo, pid_t tgid, pid_t tid, int sig, siginfo_t *info);
description: The rt_tgsigqueueinfo() system call sends a signal and associated data to a specific thread in a thread group. It allows the sender to specify the thread group ID and thread ID, with the data provided via a siginfo_t structure. This call is intended for internal use to implement functions like pthread_sigqueue(3).

parameters.name: tgid
parameters.description: Thread group ID (process ID) of the target

parameters.name: tid
parameters.description: Thread ID within the specified thread group

parameters.name: info
parameters.description: Pointer to a siginfo_t structure containing additional data for the signal

return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and errno is set to indicate the error

errors.description: The limit of signals which may be queued has been reached.
sig, tgid, or tid was invalid.
The caller does not have permission to send the signal to the target.
tgid specifies a process other than the caller and info->si_code is invalid.
No thread matching tgid and tid was found.
